name: onDataZoom
description: Fired when the data zoom range changes.

start.description: Start of the zoom window in percent (0-100).

end.description: End of the zoom window in percent (0-100).

startValue.description: Start of the zoom window as an axis value. Only present when the zoom was set by value.

endValue.description: End of the zoom window as an axis value. Only present when the zoom was set by value.

dataZoomId.description: Id of the dataZoom component that changed.

batch.description: One entry per dataZoom component when the change came from an inside (wheel/drag) zoom or a dispatched action; the top-level fields may then be absent.
